propositions: pending_enrichment walks every ticket directory and calls reduce_ticket on each, incurring ~24,000 filesystem metadata syscalls per gate check, causing 500-740 ms latency on every rebar write against a documented 20 ms budget
the gate is O(ticket-count) and fires on 100% of writes when verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets is enabled, rendering the budget-breach warning meaningless as a genuine alert signal

under concurrent writes, self-contention on the gate's own 24,000-syscall walk saturates the kernel vnode cache, causing the latency to scale with the number of simultaneous agents (reaching 2+ seconds with ~10 concurrent writers)

the fix is an O(1) marker at .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next_eligible_ns, allowing pending_enrichment to return immediately when the store is quiet and invalidating the marker only via _append so no queue state change can hide behind it
